seed_nodes.notes: PREFLIGHT CANDIDATE - NOT A LIVE SEED. node_id/peer_id are REAL public identifiers produced by the Run 375 `qbind-node identity generate devnet seed` path; the corresponding ML-KEM-768 leaf secret and in-memory ML-DSA-44 root signing key were generated in an ephemeral temp directory and DISCARDED, so this identity is illustrative only and MUST be replaced by the operator's durable seed identity before any live publication. p2p_host 203.0.113.10 is an RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 documentation address and is NOT externally reachable. status is 'planned' (NOT 'live') and last_reachability_evidence is null because external reachability from outside the operator host/NAT has NOT been proven: Run 377 proved only loopback/same-host reachability (Route B) and Run 378 attempted Route A but found no external ingress / no independent external vantage point in the sandboxed environment (Route C — infrastructure prerequisites documented in RUN_378_qbind-devnet-seed-1.md); Run 388 re-executed the Route A objective and reached the same Route C finding (prerequisites in RUN_388_qbind-devnet-seed-1.md); Run 391 re-executed it again with the same Route C finding (prerequisites in RUN_391_qbind-devnet-seed-1.md). To promote to status 'live': stand up a real externally reachable KEMTLS static-root seed, capture external reachability evidence from an independent external vantage point, set p2p_host/p2p_multiaddr/operator to the real public values, set status 'live', and set last_reachability_evidence to the evidence reference. `qbind-node identity register-check --status live --reachability-evidence <ref>` accepts exactly that shape and fails closed without the evidence reference.
